CustomField.description: Evaluates if Is 3rd party or Physical Infrastructure Product on POC. [This needs to be kept up to date with the product checkboxes.] This field is being used in the approval process to identify whether the product is 3rd party or Physical Infrastructure Product on POC on the section on the 'On-Prem page' layout.
CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( Chronicle__c = TRUE, Deep_Instinct__c = TRUE, NOT( ISBLANK( Tracking_Number__c )),
VALUE(TAN_S_330_CP_Quantity__c) >1, VALUE(TAN_S_335_FB_Quantity__c) >1, VALUE(TAN_M_430_CP_Quantity__c) >1, VALUE(TAN_M_435_FB_Quantity__c) >1, VALUE(TAN_L_730_CP_Quantity__c) >1, VALUE(TAN_L_735_FB_Quantity__c) >1, VALUE(TAN_XL_930_CP_Quantity__c) >1, VALUE(TAN_XL_935_FB_Quantity__c) >1), "TRUE ","" )
CustomField.label: Is 3rd Party or Physical Infrast Prod?
